summary: A young man in a black coat and tie walks down a bustling city sidewalk while filming himself from a low, wide-angle selfie perspective.

people.description: Young East Asian male with dark wavy hair, wearing a black trench coat over a collared shirt, dark tie, and backpack, holding the camera out while walking.

quality.issues: Accidental tilt up from ground at start and tilt down to pavement at the end.

moments.action: Creator walks down the sidewalk holding camera forward at a low angle, looking straight into the lens with a calm expression
good_for: dressed up with nowhere to go

moments.action: Creator continues walking while casually glancing off to the side toward the street and looking back at the camera
good_for: living life at my own pace
